content.text:
**Finding: compliant** — no MFN obligation burdens our side.

- Targeted searches ("most favored", "no less favorable", "favorable", "pricing", "terms and conditions offered to") surfaced no MFN construct anywhere in the agreement; the only "pricing" hit is an unrelated reference to pricing new corporate debt issues in an annex.
- A full read of Article IX (Other Agreements), the planner's primary candidate, confirms it covers only financing statements, no-transfer/lien, expenses, receivables information, no-petition, limited recourse, limitation of liability, tax treatment, Regulation RR risk retention and the Cap Collateral Account — nothing resembling best-terms or price-matching.
- As expected for a transfer and servicing agreement, there is no obligation on the Issuer or Depositor to extend Cellco terms no less favourable than those given to third parties. This sits at the preferred position, so no redline was proposed.
